Maya (CSM): Quick flag 1 KryptonWare renewal in ~5w. Usage down ~50% last 30d, embeddings + rerank hit hardest. AE notes a quiet procurement eval (NebulaAI). Need fast triage.
Jordan (AM): Any obvious trigger? recent deploy, billing bump, or config change?
Maya (CSM): They rotated API keys on 2024-11-02 and paused nightly batch jobs last week. Several seats inactive.
Devon (Eng): I checked logs for their prod key 1 seeing repeated 429s and intermittent 502s on /embed since the rotation. Snippet: `ERROR 429: quota exceeded` then `ERROR 502: gateway timeout route=/embed`
Luca (AE): I'll reach procurement. Can we buy time with a short Dedicated trial or credits?
Devon (Eng): Low-risk mitigation: enable prefix KV cache + 2x burst capacity for 72h and turn on debug logging for 48h. I can push an account override and run a smoke harness. Validation curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer prod-krypton' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embed -d '{"input":"test"}'`
Maya (CSM): Action items: Jordan - export top routes + seat activity (EOD). Devon - stage override + smoke run (24h). Luca - schedule 30m renewal triage with Priya (Dir Data), Evan (Procurement), and Ana (exec). If no engagement in 72h escalate to RevOps.
OpsBot: Reminder 1 renewal event for KryptonWare on 2025-01-01 needs exec confirmation.
Jordan (AM): Export uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/kryptonware_1769998888.csv (internal).
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Reconvene after the smoke test and before the customer call.
